source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, cash income taxes paid
source.quote: Cash paid for income tax 1,052 651 437 Non-cash financing activities: Finance [USD millions; FY2024 is the 1st figure in the row]

notes: Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid, the line does not say whether refunds are netted. R&D not reported as a separate line. MercadoLibre reports 'Product and technology development' ($1,934 million; tagged us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense in XBRL), which the 10-K describes as engineering/web-development staff, D&A, export-duty withholdings and other costs without calling it research and development, so it is not recorded.
